content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after the \"Hedge Relationship\" menu click, a coverage overlay is shown within about 10 ms and stays up until just after the hedge relationship screen navigation, so the screen appears to wait on a blocking overlay during the route change, in all three sessions.", "fix": "Fix: On the Hedging menu's \"Hedge Relationship\" menuitem, navigate to the hedge relationship screen immediately and move the loading indicator inside that screen, instead of showing a full-page overlay that only clears after the navigation event.", "cited_event_ids": ["24", "29:w26", "app:4", "25", "30:w33", "30:w32"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["What the overlay waits on (data load, API response, or route guard) is not visible in the events.", "Whether the overlay is a spinner or a modal is not shown; only 'overlay shown' and 'overlay removed' coverage events appear.", "Server or network timing for the hedge relationship request is not in the windows (no network error or request events cited).", "The exact per-user wait figures are taken from the insight facts and were not recalculated."]}
